units.goal: Understand and discuss a news report about an accident, and correct assumptions with formal negation.

grammar.title: Formal negation with 并非
grammar.pattern: A 并非 B，而是 C
grammar.explain: 并非 is the written equivalent of 并不是 'is by no means'. It is used in news, essays and speeches to reject an assumption, and is often followed by 而是 to state the real situation. In everyday speech you would normally say 并不是.

examples.zh: 失败 并非 坏事 ， 而是 成功 的 开始 。
examples.en: Failure is by no means a bad thing; it is the beginning of success.

examples.zh: 事故 的 原因 并非 天气 ， 而是 管理 不 严 。
examples.en: The cause of the accident was not the weather but lax management.

examples.zh: 并非 所有 的 网络 消息 都 可靠 。
examples.en: Not all news on the internet is reliable.

grammar.title: Playing things down with …而已
grammar.pattern: 只是 / 不过 + … + 而已
grammar.explain: 而已 at the end of a sentence means 'that's all; merely'. It plays down what has just been said and is usually paired with 只是 or 不过 earlier in the sentence. 罢了 is a more colloquial synonym.

examples.zh: 我 只是 随便 问问 而已 ， 你 别 多 想 。
examples.en: I was only asking, don't read too much into it.

examples.zh: 他 不过 是 运气 好 而已 ， 实力 并 不 怎么样 。
examples.en: He was just lucky — his real ability is nothing special.

grammar.title: 毫无 + abstract noun
grammar.pattern: 毫无 + 意义 / 疑问 / 进展 / 准备 / 兴趣
grammar.explain: 毫无 means 'without the slightest'. It is written in style and is followed by a two-syllable abstract noun. The spoken equivalent is 一点儿…也没有 or 完全没有.

reading.title: 仓库爆炸事故最新进展
reading.zh: 昨天下午三点左右，城东一家物流公司的仓库发生爆炸。事故发生后，消防人员迅速赶到现场，并将附近区域的四百多名居民转移到了安全地点。据有关部门证实，截至目前，事故尚未造成人员死亡，但有十二人受伤，其中两人伤势较重。爆炸的原因仍在调查之中。有网友在网络上发布视频，称爆炸前曾闻到异常气味，还有附近居民出现了头晕、恶心等症状。对此，调查机构表示，这些说法的来源还有待核实，网上流传的信息并非都可靠，希望媒体和公众不要传播未经证实的消息。该公司负责人在接受采访时承诺，公司将全力配合调查，尽快查明真相，并对受影响的社区居民给予补偿。有业内人士评论说，这一事件本身并不复杂，却暴露出部分企业安全意识淡薄的问题：有的仓库长期超量存放危险物品，安全检查的档案几乎毫无记录。一位社区工作人员说：“大家最关心的是，以后怎样确保类似的事故不再发生。”目前，现场周边的交通已基本维持正常，有关部门仍在二十四小时盯着现场情况。本报将继续关注事件进展。
reading.en: At around three o'clock yesterday afternoon, an explosion occurred at a warehouse belonging to a logistics company in the east of the city. After the accident, firefighters quickly arrived at the scene and moved more than four hundred residents of the surrounding area to safety. According to the authorities, the accident has so far caused no deaths, but twelve people were injured, two of them seriously. The cause of the explosion is still under investigation. Some internet users posted videos online claiming that they had smelled an unusual odor before the blast, and some nearby residents developed symptoms such as dizziness and nausea. In response, the investigating agency said that the sources of these claims still need to be verified, that not all the information circulating online is reliable, and asked the media and the public not to spread unconfirmed reports. In an interview, the head of the company promised that the company would cooperate fully with the investigation, find out the truth as soon as possible, and compensate the affected residents of the community. One industry insider commented that the incident itself was not complicated, but it exposed a weak sense of safety at some companies: some warehouses had long stored excessive amounts of dangerous goods, and their safety inspection files contained almost no records at all. A community worker said: "What everyone cares about most is how to make sure a similar accident never happens again." At present, traffic around the scene is basically back to normal, and the relevant departments are still monitoring the site around the clock. This paper will continue to follow the developments.

grammar.title: Even if: 即便…也…
grammar.pattern: 即便 + condition，(主语) + 也 + result
grammar.explain: 即便 is a more formal synonym of 即使 'even if'. The first clause gives a hypothetical or real extreme situation, and the second clause, with 也, says that the result does not change. It is common in writing and speeches.

examples.zh: 即便 失败 了 ， 这 次 经历 也 很 有 价值 。
examples.en: Even if we fail, this experience is still very valuable.

examples.zh: 即便 是 专家 ， 也 难免 会 犯错 。
examples.en: Even experts make mistakes sometimes.

grammar.title: Formal 'give': 给予 + abstract noun
grammar.pattern: 给予 + (对象) + 支持 / 帮助 / 奖励 / 肯定 / 关注
grammar.explain: 给予 (jǐyǔ) means 'to give, to grant' in formal writing. Its object is an abstract, usually two-syllable noun such as 支持, 帮助 or 评价, not a concrete thing. For handing over objects, use 给.

examples.zh: 政府 对 受灾 地区 给予 了 大力 支持 。
examples.en: The government gave strong support to the disaster area.

examples.zh: 老师 对 他 的 进步 给予 了 充分 的 肯定 。
examples.en: The teacher fully recognized his progress.

grammar.title: Be located in: 位于
grammar.pattern: 地点 / 机构 + 位于 + 地方
grammar.explain: 位于 means 'to be situated in/at'. It is the formal counterpart of 在 for buildings, cities and organizations, and is typical of guidebooks, news and company profiles.

examples.zh: 这 座 博物馆 位于 市中心 ， 交通 十分 方便 。
examples.en: The museum is located in the city center and is very easy to reach.

examples.zh: 公司 总部 位于 上海 。
examples.en: The company's headquarters is in Shanghai.

reading.title: 新一代卫星发射成功
reading.zh: 今天凌晨两点十五分，一枚新型运载火箭在位于海南的发射中心点火升空，成功将三颗卫星送入预定轨道。这是我国航空航天事业今年取得的又一项重要突破。整个发射过程通过网络进行了全程直播，吸引了数百万观众在线观看。镜头里，火箭拖着长长的火焰冲向夜空，现场一片欢呼。据项目主管介绍，与以往相比，这次使用的火箭动力更强，操作系统也更加先进，许多关键环节都实现了自动化。不过，研发过程十分艰难。团队曾经连续三次试验失败，有人开始抱怨，甚至想要放弃。“那段时间大家压力都很大，但即便在最困难的时候，也没有一个人真正离开。”他说，“正是靠着团结和激情，我们才走到了今天。”据悉，这批卫星将主要用于天气预报和灾害监测，可以为农业、交通等领域提供更准确的数据。专家评估认为，随着相关需求不断增长，卫星技术将给人们的生活带来越来越大的回报。发射结束后，有关部门发布声明，对全体科研人员的辛勤工作给予高度评价，并表示将对做出突出贡献的人员给予奖励。
reading.en: At 2:15 this morning, a new type of carrier rocket lifted off from the launch center in Hainan and successfully placed three satellites into their planned orbits. This is another important breakthrough for the country's aerospace industry this year. The whole launch was streamed live online, attracting millions of viewers. On camera, the rocket trailed a long flame as it shot into the night sky, and the crowd at the site cheered. According to the project supervisor, compared with the past, the rocket used this time has more power and a more advanced control system, and many key stages have been automated. The development process, however, was very hard. The team once failed three tests in a row; some people began to complain and even wanted to give up. "Everyone was under a lot of pressure during that period, but even at the hardest moments, not a single person actually left," he said. "It was unity and passion that brought us to where we are today." It is reported that these satellites will mainly be used for weather forecasting and disaster monitoring, and can provide more accurate data for fields such as agriculture and transport. Experts estimate that as demand keeps growing, satellite technology will bring ever greater returns to people's lives. After the launch, the relevant authorities issued a statement praising the hard work of all the researchers and saying that those who had made outstanding contributions would be rewarded.

grammar.title: Classical adverbs 皆 and 亦
grammar.pattern: 皆 = 都 ； 亦 = 也 (书面语)
grammar.explain: In formal writing and set phrases, 皆 replaces 都 and 亦 replaces 也. They go before the verb just like 都 and 也, and are common in laws, notices, news and proverbs. Using them in casual speech sounds bookish.

examples.zh: 此 事 人人 皆 知 。
examples.en: Everyone knows about this.

grammar.title: Stating the obvious: 明明…却…
grammar.pattern: 明明 + 事实 ， 却 / 还 / 怎么 + 相反的行为
grammar.explain: 明明 stresses that something is plainly true; the next clause shows behavior that contradicts it, often with surprise or complaint. 明明 comes before the verb or adjective, and the second clause usually has 却, 还 or a question with 怎么.

grammar.title: At least and more than: 起码 / 不止
grammar.pattern: 起码 + 数量 ； 不止 + 数量 / 名词
grammar.explain: 起码 means 'at the very least' and is a little more colloquial than 至少; 最起码 strengthens it. 不止 means 'more than; not just', and is followed by a number or a noun phrase.

reading.title: 一场消费者诉讼
reading.zh: 去年三月，市民刘女士在一家商场购买了一台标有“进口原装”的按摩椅，花了将近两万元。使用不到一个月，机器就频繁出现故障。经专业机构检验，这台按摩椅的主要零件都是国产的，所谓“进口”纯属虚假宣传。刘女士多次要求商家退货并给予补偿，对方却以各种理由推脱。无奈之下，她决定向法院提起诉讼。据刘女士的代理律师介绍，起初她也犹豫过：“打官司费时费力，要不就算了吧。”但律师告诉她，诉讼不止是为了拿回自己的钱，也是在保障更多消费者的权益。经过两次开庭审判，法院近日作出一审判决：被告商场的行为构成欺诈，须退还全部货款，并按照法律规定赔偿三倍的损失。判决结果公布后，不少群众在网上留言，认为这一判决“公正、及时”。法律专家指出，近年来，消费纠纷案件的数量呈现上升趋势。据统计，去年全市法院受理的此类案件比上一年度增加了百分之二十。专家认为，要彻底消除虚假宣传，起码需要做到三点：一是行政机关加强监督；二是企业摆脱“重销售、轻服务”的思维；三是消费者遇到问题时，不要因为怕麻烦而放弃维权。“司法只是最后一道防线。只有每个当事人都敢于站出来，市场才能真正和谐有序。”
reading.en: Last March, a local resident, Ms. Liu, bought a massage chair labeled "original import" at a shopping mall for nearly twenty thousand yuan. Less than a month later, the machine kept breaking down. Testing by a professional agency found that the chair's main parts were all domestically made, and the so-called "import" claim was pure false advertising. Ms. Liu repeatedly asked the seller to take back the product and compensate her, but they made all kinds of excuses. Having no other choice, she decided to file a lawsuit. According to Ms. Liu's lawyer, at first she had hesitated: "Going to court takes time and effort; maybe I should just forget it." But the lawyer told her that a lawsuit was not only about getting her own money back, but also about protecting the rights of many more consumers. After two court hearings, the court recently handed down its first-instance verdict: the defendant mall's conduct constituted fraud; it had to refund the full price and, as the law requires, pay compensation of three times the loss. After the verdict was announced, many members of the public left comments online saying it was "fair and timely". Legal experts point out that in recent years the number of consumer disputes has been rising. Statistics show that the number of such cases accepted by the city's courts last year was 20% higher than the year before. Experts believe that to eliminate false advertising completely, at least three things are needed: first, administrative agencies must strengthen supervision; second, businesses must break free of the mindset of "valuing sales over service"; third, consumers who run into problems should not give up defending their rights just because it is troublesome. "The judiciary is only the last line of defense. Only when every party involved dares to stand up can the market be truly harmonious and orderly."

grammar.title: Enough to: 足以 + verb

grammar.explain: 过于 means 'too, excessively'. It is more formal than 太 and almost always implies criticism. It usually goes before a two-syllable adjective or verb, and does not take 了 at the end the way 太…了 does.

grammar.title: 一向 vs 一直
grammar.pattern: 一向 + 习惯 / 特点 ； 一直 + 持续的动作
grammar.explain: Both mean 'always'. 一向 describes a habit, attitude or trait that has held true from the past until now (他一向很节约). 一直 stresses that an action or state continues without a break over a period, which can be a specific span of time (一直等到十点); it can also mean 'straight ahead'. 一向 cannot describe a single continuous action.

reading.title: 《雾中码头》：一部值得一看的悬疑片
reading.zh: 最近上映的悬疑片《雾中码头》改编自同名漫画，讲述了一个关于欲望与正义的故事。一位富商去世后，留下一座海边别墅和一颗价值连城的钻石。就在小女儿要做新娘的前一天，钻石突然不见了，现场只留下一些模糊的痕迹。几个继承人互相猜疑，每个人似乎都有作案动机：大儿子一向嫉妒妹妹得到父亲的宠爱，二儿子在金融投资上亏了一大笔钱……年轻的女警察依据一个个细节，一步步揭开了真相。与以往同类电影相比，这部片子的剧本相当扎实。导演把爱情、家庭和犯罪等元素结合得很自然，情节层层推进，节奏紧凑，高潮部分的场面尤其精彩，足以让观众屏住呼吸。值得一提的是，扮演女警察的演员几乎没有化妆，却凭借清晰有力的表演牢牢抓住了观众的目光。当然，影片也存在一些失误。有些对话过于直白，结尾的反转略显牵强，似乎是为了制造惊喜而强迫故事拐弯。此外，电影版本删掉了漫画中几个迷人的配角，原作的粉丝难免感到遗憾。总的来说，这是一部制作用心、充满乐趣的作品。如果你喜欢动脑筋，不妨走进影院，跟着女主角一起寻找答案。
reading.en: The recently released mystery film Pier in the Fog is adapted from a comic of the same name and tells a story about desire and justice. After a wealthy businessman dies, he leaves behind a seaside villa and a priceless diamond. On the day before his youngest daughter's wedding, the diamond suddenly vanishes, leaving only a few faint traces at the scene. The heirs suspect one another, and each seems to have a motive: the eldest son has always been jealous of the father's affection for his sister, and the second son has lost a fortune on financial investments... Relying on one detail after another, a young policewoman gradually uncovers the truth. Compared with earlier films of this kind, this one has a rather solid script. The director blends elements of romance, family and crime quite naturally; the plot builds layer by layer, the pacing is tight, and the scenes at the climax are especially gripping — enough to make the audience hold their breath. It is worth noting that the actress who plays the policewoman wears almost no makeup, yet holds the audience's gaze with a clear and powerful performance. Of course, the film has its flaws. Some of the dialogue is too blunt, and the twist at the end feels a bit forced, as though the story had been made to change direction just to create a surprise. In addition, the film version cuts several charming supporting characters from the comic, which fans of the original will inevitably regret. All in all, this is a carefully made and highly enjoyable work. If you like to use your brain, you might as well go to the cinema and look for the answer together with the heroine.

grammar.title: In view of: 鉴于…
grammar.pattern: 鉴于 + 情况 / 原因 ， （主语） + 决定 / 采取…
grammar.explain: 鉴于 means 'in view of, considering'. It introduces a reason at the start of a formal sentence, typically in notices, reports and official decisions; the main clause then states the decision. In speech people say 考虑到 or 因为.

examples.zh: 鉴于 天气 原因 ， 本 次 航班 将 推迟 起飞 。
examples.en: Due to the weather, this flight will be delayed.

examples.zh: 鉴于 他 的 突出 表现 ， 公司 决定 给予 奖励 。

grammar.title: So that: …，以便…
grammar.pattern: 动作 ， 以便 + 目的
grammar.explain: 以便 means 'so that; in order to make it easier to'. It opens the second clause and introduces the purpose of the first action. It is formal, and the purpose clause often contains 能 or 可以. Compare 以免, which introduces something you want to avoid.

examples.zh: 请 留下 您 的 电话 ， 以便 我们 及时 联系 您 。

grammar.title: Would rather: 宁愿…也…
grammar.pattern: 宁愿 + A ， 也不 + B ； 宁愿 + A ， 也要 + B
grammar.explain: 宁愿 means 'would rather'. 宁愿 A 也不 B: you choose A, unpleasant as it is, rather than B. 宁愿 A 也要 B: you accept the cost A in order to get B. 宁可 is a close synonym.

reading.title: 在公司年会上的讲话
reading.zh: 各位股东、各位同事、各位家属朋友：大家晚上好！过去的一年，对我们来说是很不平凡的一年。当前，行业竞争日益残酷，原材料成本持续上涨，不少同行在挣扎中被迫退出了市场。鉴于这种局势，公司年初提出了“品质优先、创新驱动”的发展方向。事实证明，这个选择是正确的：我们的新产品一上市就成了市场的焦点，在国内中高端市场占据了将近三成的份额。坦白地说，一年前，很多人都认为这是不可思议的。取得这样的成绩，离不开每一位员工在各自岗位上的拼命付出。在此，我代表公司向大家表示衷心的感谢！新的一年，我们面临的挑战依然不少。为了减少对单一市场的依赖，公司决定把业务分散到更多地区，并通过互联网渠道直接面向消费者。同时，我们将进一步完善员工福利制度，以便吸引更多一流人才。董事会已经初步通过了一项提议：拿出部分股份，奖励给表现突出的员工，让大家真正成为公司的主人。最后，我想说，企业发展的前提是诚信。我们宁愿少赚一点，也绝不拿产品品质冒险。我相信，只要我们坚定信心、团结一致，就一定能创造更大的辉煌！谢谢大家！
reading.en: Dear shareholders, colleagues, family members and friends, Good evening! The past year was an extraordinary one for us. At present, competition in our industry is increasingly brutal and raw material costs keep rising; many of our peers struggled and were forced out of the market. In view of this situation, at the start of the year the company put forward the direction of "quality first, driven by innovation". Facts have proven this was the right choice: our new products became the focus of the market as soon as they launched, and we captured nearly thirty percent of the domestic mid- to high-end market. To be honest, a year ago many people thought this was unimaginable. These results would have been impossible without every employee working all-out in their own position. I would like to take this opportunity to express the company's heartfelt thanks to all of you! In the new year we still face many challenges. To reduce our dependence on a single market, the company has decided to spread its business across more regions and to reach consumers directly through online channels. At the same time, we will further improve our employee benefits so that we can attract more top talent. The board has given preliminary approval to a proposal to set aside some shares as rewards for outstanding employees, so that everyone truly becomes an owner of the company. Finally, I want to say that integrity is the precondition for a company's growth. We would rather earn a little less than ever gamble with the quality of our products. I believe that as long as we stay confident and united, we will certainly achieve even greater success! Thank you all!

grammar.title: Quite, rather: 颇 / 颇为 / 颇有
grammar.pattern: 颇 + 形容词/动词 ； 颇为 + 双音节词 ； 颇有 + 名词
grammar.explain: 颇 means 'quite, considerably'. It is a written-style degree adverb roughly equal to 很 or 相当. 颇为 is used before two-syllable adjectives or verbs, and 颇有 + noun means 'to have a fair amount of'.

examples.zh: 这 部 小说 在 年轻 人 中 颇 受 欢迎 。
examples.en: This novel is quite popular among young people.

examples.zh: 他 的 话 颇 有 道理 。
examples.en: What he says makes a lot of sense.

examples.zh: 这 个 问题 颇为 复杂 。
examples.en: This issue is rather complicated.

grammar.title: No exception: 也不例外 / 无一例外
grammar.pattern: … ， A 也 不 例外 ； 无 一 例外 + 都…
grammar.explain: 例外 is both a noun ('exception') and a verb ('to be an exception'). …，A也不例外 at the end of a statement means 'and A is no exception'. 无一例外 (formal) means 'without a single exception' and is followed by 都.

examples.zh: 每 个 人 都 会 犯错 ， 专家 也 不 例外 。
examples.en: Everyone makes mistakes, and experts are no exception.

examples.zh: 参加 考试 的 学生 无 一 例外 都 通过 了 。
examples.en: All the students who took the exam passed, without exception.

grammar.title: 看待 vs 对待
grammar.pattern: 看待 + 问题 / 现象 （态度、看法） ； 对待 + 人 / 工作 （行为）
grammar.explain: Both can be translated 'treat', but 看待 is about how you view or regard something — an attitude in your mind (怎么看待这个问题?). 对待 is about how you actually behave toward a person or a task (认真对待工作, 平等对待每个人).

reading.title: 高血压：不能忽视的“无声杀手”
reading.zh: 高血压被称为“无声的杀手”，因为它在早期往往没有明显症状，很多患者直到出现严重问题才发现。据权威机构统计，我国成年人中高血压患者已超过两亿，而且呈现出年轻化的趋势。医学研究表明，高血压的成因颇为复杂。一方面，它与遗传有关：父母患有高血压的人，发病的可能性明显更高。另一方面，不健康的生活方式也起着重要作用。长期饮食过咸、摄入过多脂肪、过量饮用含酒精的饮料，以及缺乏运动、精神紧张，都会使血管失去弹性，导致动脉硬化，进而使血压升高。值得注意的是，高血压本身并不可怕，可怕的是对它的忽视。不少人觉得自己年轻、身体好，从来不量血压；也有人确诊后不按时吃药，觉得“没感觉就是没事”。医生提醒，这样看待疾病是十分危险的，因为长期血压过高会损害心、脑、肾等重要器官。那么，应该如何预防和控制高血压呢？专家给出了几条建议：第一，调整饮食结构，少吃盐和油炸食品，多吃蔬菜水果；第二，坚持适量运动，每周至少锻炼三到五次；第三，学会调节情绪，保持心情愉快；第四，定期检查身体，家里不妨准备一台血压计，以便随时了解自己的健康现状。必要时，还应在医生指导下服用药物，以抑制血压上升。只要及早着手，纠正不良习惯，高血压完全可以得到有效控制。
reading.en: High blood pressure is called the "silent killer" because in its early stages there are often no obvious symptoms, and many patients only find out when serious problems arise. According to statistics from authoritative bodies, there are now more than two hundred million adults in the country with high blood pressure, and the condition is affecting ever younger people. Medical research shows that the causes of high blood pressure are rather complex. On the one hand, it is related to heredity: people whose parents have high blood pressure are clearly more likely to develop it. On the other hand, an unhealthy lifestyle also plays an important role. A long-term diet that is too salty, eating too much fat, drinking too much alcohol, as well as lack of exercise and mental stress can all make blood vessels lose their elasticity and lead to hardening of the arteries, which in turn raises blood pressure. It is worth noting that high blood pressure itself is not frightening; what is frightening is ignoring it. Many people think they are young and healthy and never have their blood pressure checked; others, after being diagnosed, do not take their medicine on time, thinking "if I don't feel anything, nothing is wrong." Doctors warn that viewing the illness this way is very dangerous, because long-term high blood pressure damages vital organs such as the heart, brain and kidneys. So how can high blood pressure be prevented and controlled? Experts offer several suggestions: first, adjust your diet, eating less salt and fried food and more fruit and vegetables; second, exercise regularly in moderation, at least three to five times a week; third, learn to manage your emotions and stay cheerful; fourth, have regular check-ups — it is a good idea to keep a blood pressure monitor at home so that you know the current state of your health at any time. When necessary, you should also take medication under a doctor's guidance to keep your blood pressure from rising. As long as you start early and correct bad habits, high blood pressure can be brought under effective control.

grammar.title: At any cost: 不惜
grammar.pattern: 不惜 + 代价 / 一切 / 动词短语
grammar.explain: 不惜 means 'to not hesitate to (pay a high price)'. It shows that someone is willing to sacrifice money, effort or something precious to reach a goal. Typical phrases are 不惜一切代价 and 不惜 + a costly action.

grammar.title: To such an extent: 到…的地步
grammar.pattern: （发展 / 严重）到 + 程度 + 的 地步
grammar.explain: 地步 means 'extent, point', usually a bad state of affairs. 到…的地步 or 到了这种地步 emphasizes how far a situation has gone. It often appears in rhetorical questions.

grammar.title: Luckily…otherwise: 幸好…，不然…
grammar.pattern: 幸好 + 有利情况 ， 不然 / 否则 + 坏结果
grammar.explain: 幸好 'luckily' introduces a fortunate fact that prevented a bad outcome, and the next clause with 不然 or 否则 says what would have happened. 幸亏 is a close synonym.

reading.title: 回乡的年轻人
reading.zh: 大学毕业那年，李阳拿到了硕士学位，在一座繁华的都市找到了一份收入不错的工作。可是五年后，他却做出了一个让所有人吃惊的决策：辞职回到偏远的家乡种茶。消息传开后，外界议论纷纷。有亲戚嘲笑他“读了那么多书，最后还是回来种地”，觉得他让父母丢了面子；也有朋友劝他好好想想，别一时冲动。父母起初也只是勉强同意。然而李阳心里很清楚：家乡虽然遥远、贫困，却有着得天独厚的自然条件，缺少的只是懂技术、懂市场的人。“城市生活固然便利，但我更乐意把学到的知识用在自己熟悉的土地上。”回乡后，他先花了半年时间到各地考察，又不惜拿出全部积蓄，建起了一个小型茶叶加工厂。他注重品质，每一道工序都亲自把关；同时开展网络销售，把村里的茶叶卖到了全国各地。他还把加工后剩下的茶渣回收起来，做成肥料，免费送给村民。创业的过程是漫长而艰难的。有一年遭遇罕见的冰冻天气，茶叶几乎颗粒无收，他也曾怀疑过自己的选择。但伴随着一次次挫折，他的茶园反而越办越好。如今，村里已有三十多户人家跟着他一起种茶，许多外出打工的年轻人也陆续回来了。“老一辈人用岁月守护了这片土地，我希望把这份坚持延续下去。”李阳说。他的选择至今仍有争议，但他用行动证明：在家乡同样可以实现人生的价值。
reading.en: The year he graduated, Li Yang earned his master's degree and found a well-paid job in a bustling metropolis. Five years later, however, he made a decision that surprised everyone: he quit his job and went back to his remote hometown to grow tea. When the news got out, people had plenty to say. Some relatives mocked him for "studying all those years only to come back and farm," feeling he had made his parents lose face; some friends urged him to think it over carefully and not act on impulse. At first even his parents only agreed reluctantly. But Li Yang knew exactly what he was doing: though his hometown was remote and poor, it had exceptional natural conditions — what it lacked were people who understood technology and markets. "City life is certainly convenient, but I'd rather use what I've learned on land I know well." After returning, he first spent half a year visiting other places to study their methods, then spent all his savings to build a small tea-processing plant. He paid close attention to quality, personally checking every step of the process; at the same time he started selling online, bringing the village's tea to every part of the country. He also collected the tea leftovers from processing, turned them into fertilizer and gave it to the villagers for free. Starting the business was a long, hard road. One year a rare freeze struck and the tea harvest was almost completely lost; he too began to doubt his choice. But through one setback after another, his tea garden actually grew stronger. Today more than thirty households in the village grow tea with him, and many young people who had left to work elsewhere have been coming back one after another. "The older generation spent their lives protecting this land, and I hope to carry that commitment forward," Li Yang says. His choice is still debated, but he has shown through his actions that one can realize one's worth in one's hometown too.

reading.title: 选专业，别盲目跟随潮流
reading.zh: 每年高考结束后，填报志愿都会成为许多家庭讨论的焦点。近来，一项针对大学新生的调查显示，超过一半的学生在选择专业时主要考虑的是“就业前景”和“未来报酬”，真正出于兴趣的只占不到三成。这种做法可以理解。毕竟，不同行业之间的收入差距确实存在，谁都希望毕业后能有一条好出路。然而，盲目跟随潮流的风险也不容忽视。所谓“热门专业”，往往是根据当前的市场需求判断的，而市场变化之快常常超出人们的预料。几年前大家抢着报考的专业，等到毕业时也许已经人满为患。到那时，不少学生虽然手里拿着各种证书，却发现自己的处境颇为尴尬：既找不到相应的工作，又对所学内容毫无兴趣，难免感到沮丧。教育专家认为，选择专业的首要标准应该是兴趣和特长。兴趣是最好的老师，它能激发一个人内在的动力，让人在忙碌和压力中依然保持热情。智力水平相近的两个人，一个做自己喜欢的事，一个勉强应付，几年后的差距可能相当惊人。许多杰出的科学家和艺术家，正是因为一生致力于自己热爱的领域，才从平凡走向了成功。当然，强调兴趣并不意味着可以完全不考虑现实。专家建议，学生在填报志愿之前，不妨多花些时间了解各个专业的具体内容，必要时向老师和学长请教，以免因为误解而做出错误的决定。家长也应树立正确的观念，尊重孩子的选择，而不是把自己的愿望强加给孩子。
reading.en: Every year after the college entrance exam, filling in university applications becomes a focus of discussion in many families. A recent survey of first-year university students showed that more than half mainly considered "job prospects" and "future pay" when choosing a major, while fewer than thirty percent chose out of genuine interest. This is understandable. After all, income gaps between industries really do exist, and everyone hopes to have good career options after graduating. However, the risk of blindly following trends should not be overlooked. So-called "hot majors" are usually judged on current market demand, and markets often change faster than people expect. A major everyone scrambled to apply for a few years ago may be oversubscribed by the time they graduate. By then, many students, despite holding all kinds of certificates, find themselves in a rather awkward position: they cannot find suitable jobs, and they have no interest in what they studied, so it is no wonder they feel discouraged. Education experts believe that the most important criteria for choosing a major should be interest and aptitude. Interest is the best teacher: it can spark a person's inner motivation and keep them enthusiastic despite busyness and pressure. Of two people of similar intelligence, one doing what they love and one just getting by, the gap after a few years can be astonishing. Many outstanding scientists and artists rose from ordinary beginnings to success precisely because they devoted their lives to fields they loved. Of course, emphasizing interest does not mean ignoring reality altogether. Experts suggest that before filling in their applications, students should spend some time learning what each major actually involves, and if necessary ask teachers and older students for advice, so as to avoid making wrong decisions based on misunderstandings. Parents should also adopt the right attitude and respect their children's choices instead of imposing their own wishes on them.

reading.title: 一个电话，差点骗走了二十万
reading.zh: 上个月，退休教师王阿姨接到一个陌生电话。对方自称是某银行的工作人员，说她的账户涉嫌洗钱，必须马上把钱转到所谓的“安全账户”，否则账户会被冻结。为了让王阿姨相信，对方还准确说出了她的姓名、住址和身份证号码，并发来一份盖着红章的“书面通知”。王阿姨一贯谨慎，可这一次却慌了神。她不顾家人的劝阻，按照对方的要求，在手机上登录了一个陌生网站，输入了银行卡密码和验证码。就在她准备把将近二十万元的存款全部转出时，银行工作人员发现情况异常，及时打电话核实，才挽救了这笔钱。警方很快锁定了嫌疑人，并依法对其进行了刑事拘留。据嫌疑人交代，他们专门挑选老年人下手，利用的正是老人害怕担责任、不愿麻烦子女的心态。眼下，随着智能手机的普及，诈骗手段也在不断“升级”。骗子会冒充熟人、客服甚至警察，用虚假的中奖信息、高收益的投资项目等诱惑受害者。民警推测，这类骗局之所以屡屡得手，是因为骗子抓住了人们的弱点：贪小便宜、轻信权威、遇事慌张。对此，警方提醒广大市民：第一，银行卡密码、验证码等属于个人机密，切勿告诉任何人；第二，公安机关不会通过电话办案，更不存在所谓的“安全账户”；第三，遇到可疑情况，先挂断电话，再拨打110核实。王阿姨坦白地说：“原先我觉得骗子只会骗那些糊涂的人，现在才知道，谁都可能上当。”
reading.en: Last month, Aunt Wang, a retired teacher, received a call from an unknown number. The caller claimed to work for a bank and said her account was suspected of money laundering, so she had to transfer her money immediately to a so-called "safe account", or the account would be frozen. To win her trust, the caller correctly gave her name, address and ID number, and sent her a "written notice" bearing a red official seal. Aunt Wang has always been cautious, but this time she panicked. Ignoring her family's attempts to stop her, she followed the caller's instructions, logged on to an unfamiliar website on her phone, and entered her bank card password and verification code. Just as she was about to transfer nearly two hundred thousand yuan in savings, bank staff noticed something unusual and called her promptly to check, saving the money. The police soon identified the suspects and detained them under criminal law. According to a suspect's confession, they specifically targeted elderly people, exploiting their fear of being held responsible and their reluctance to trouble their children. Today, as smartphones become widespread, fraud methods keep "upgrading". Swindlers impersonate acquaintances, customer service staff and even police officers, luring victims with fake prize notifications and high-return investment schemes. The police believe these scams succeed again and again because the fraudsters exploit people's weaknesses: the urge to grab a small bargain, blind trust in authority, and panic when something happens. The police therefore remind the public: first, bank card passwords and verification codes are personal secrets — never tell anyone; second, the police do not handle cases over the phone, and there is no such thing as a "safe account"; third, if anything seems suspicious, hang up first and then call 110 to check. Aunt Wang admitted frankly: "I used to think swindlers only fooled muddle-headed people. Now I know anyone can be taken in."

units.goal: Read a story about restoring a polluted stream and make suggestions and complaints with 不妨, 偏偏 and 要不然.

grammar.title: Might as well: 不妨
grammar.pattern: 不妨 + 动词短语 （试试 / 先… / V 一下）
grammar.explain: 不妨 means 'there's no harm in; might as well'. It makes a polite, gentle suggestion and is more tactful than 应该. It is often followed by 试试, 先, or a verb + 一下.

examples.zh: 你 不妨 换 个 角度 想想 。
examples.en: You might try looking at it from a different angle.

examples.zh: 既然 来 了 ， 不妨 多 住 几 天 。
examples.en: Since you're here, you might as well stay a few more days.

grammar.title: Contrary to wishes: 偏偏
grammar.pattern: （主语）+ 偏偏 + 与愿望相反的事
grammar.explain: 偏偏 says that something happened contrary to what was wanted or expected, often with frustration ('as luck would have it'). With a person as subject it can also mean someone stubbornly does the opposite of what others want.

examples.zh: 我 急着 出门 ， 偏偏 找 不 到 钥匙 。

examples.zh: 大家 都 劝 他 别 去 ， 他 偏偏 要 去 。

grammar.title: Otherwise: 要不然 / 否则
grammar.pattern: A ， 要不然 / 否则 + 后果
grammar.explain: 要不然 means 'otherwise, or else'. It introduces what will happen if the advice or condition in the first clause is not followed. 否则 is more formal and 不然 is shorter. 要不然 can also introduce an alternative suggestion.

examples.zh: 快 带 上 伞 ， 要不然 会 淋 湿 的 。

reading.title: 一条小溪的复活
reading.zh: 我家门前有一条小溪。小时候，溪水清澈见底，夏天我们常在里面捉鱼、游泳。可是后来，上游陆续建起了几家小工厂，污水未经处理就被擅自排进溪里。没过几年，溪水变得又黑又臭，鱼虾统统不见了，岸边的垃圾时常堆成小山。村民们心里着急，却不知道该找谁。转机出现在五年前。一位记者在报纸上刊登了一篇文章，揭露了工厂偷排污水的问题，引起了有关部门的重视。环保部门随即进行干预，对违法企业进行了严厉处罚，并追究了相关负责人的责任。随后，当地政府提出了一个大胆的设想：不仅要治理污染，还要让小溪恢复先前的生态。起初，有人怀疑这个计划是否可行，毕竟治理需要大量开支，偏偏当地财政又不宽裕。但专家们遵循“自然修复为主、人工干预为辅”的原则，先清理河道，再种植水草，然后定期投放鱼苗，花钱并不多。许多村民也默默加入了志愿者的队伍，每天在岸边拾垃圾。前年夏天，一场洪水冲毁了部分堤岸，大家吸取教训，又沿着小溪修了一条长长的绿化带，一直延伸到山脚下。如今，小溪终于“复活”了。溪水重新变得清澈，水鸟也飞了回来。到了周末，城里人开车来这里搭帐篷、看风光，村里还开起了好几家农家乐。看着崭新的村庄，老人们的喜悦之情溢于言表。一位老人感慨地说：“过去我们无知，只顾眼前的利益，终究还是要付出代价的。好在一切还来得及。”
reading.en: There is a stream in front of my house. When I was a child, its water was so clear you could see the bottom, and in summer we often caught fish and swam in it. Later, however, several small factories were built upstream one after another, and their wastewater was dumped into the stream without permission or treatment. Within a few years the water had turned black and foul, the fish and shrimp had all disappeared, and garbage often piled up like small hills on the banks. The villagers were worried but did not know whom to turn to. The turning point came five years ago. A journalist published an article in a newspaper exposing the factories' illegal discharges, which caught the attention of the authorities. The environmental protection department immediately intervened, severely punished the companies breaking the law, and held those responsible to account. After that, the local government put forward a bold idea: not only to clean up the pollution, but to restore the stream's former ecology. At first some people doubted whether the plan was feasible, since the cleanup would require a great deal of spending, and as luck would have it, local finances were tight. But the experts followed the principle of "natural recovery first, human intervention second": they first cleared the riverbed, then planted water plants, and later released young fish at regular intervals, which did not cost much. Many villagers also quietly joined the volunteers, picking up litter along the banks every day. The summer before last, a flood washed away part of the embankment; learning from this, everyone built a long green belt along the stream, stretching all the way to the foot of the mountain. Today the stream has finally "come back to life". The water is clear again and the waterbirds have returned. On weekends, city people drive here to pitch tents and enjoy the scenery, and the village has opened several farm-stay guesthouses. Looking at the brand-new village, the old folks' joy is plain to see. One old man said with feeling: "In the past we were ignorant and cared only about immediate gain — sooner or later you pay the price. Luckily it wasn't too late."

units.title: Rumors and the Media

grammar.title: Can't help it: 不禁
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 不禁 + 动词 （笑 / 哭 / 想起 / 担心…）
grammar.explain: 不禁 means 'cannot help (doing)'. It describes an emotional reaction that happens involuntarily, usually triggered by something in the previous clause. 不由得 is a close synonym, and 忍不住 is the everyday equivalent.

examples.zh: 听 到 这 个 消息 ， 她 不禁 流 下 了 眼泪 。
examples.en: When she heard the news, she couldn't hold back her tears.

examples.zh: 看着 孩子 们 的 笑脸 ， 他 不禁 笑 了 起来 。

grammar.title: Bound to happen: 难免
grammar.pattern: 难免 + （会） + 动词 ； …是 难免 的
grammar.explain: 难免 means 'hard to avoid; only natural'. It presents a less-than-ideal result as understandable in the circumstances. It can come before the verb (often with 会) or at the end as 是难免的.

examples.zh: 第一 次 上台 ， 难免 会 紧张 。
examples.en: It's only natural to be nervous the first time on stage.

examples.zh: 刚 开始 工作 ， 犯 点儿 错误 是 难免 的 。

grammar.title: At worst: 大不了
grammar.pattern: 大不了 + 最坏的打算 ； 有 什么 大不了 的
grammar.explain: 大不了 means 'at worst; if the worst comes to the worst'. It names the worst possible outcome to show it is acceptable, so it sounds brave or carefree. 有什么大不了的 / 没什么大不了的 means 'it's no big deal'.

examples.zh: 试试 吧 ， 大不了 失败 一 次 。

reading.title: 一则谣言引发的风波
reading.zh: 上个月，一篇标题为《某品牌奶粉被查出有害物质》的文章在网上迅速传播，一度引起轩然大波。不少家长看后不禁担心起来，有的甚至把家里刚买的奶粉全部扔掉。在这种情况下，家长感到恐慌是难免的。该品牌的销量在短短一周内下降了近四成。面对突如其来的危机，公司起初选择沉默，希望风波自行平息，结果谣言愈传愈烈。在公关专家的建议下，公司终于公开表态：一方面邀请权威检测机构对产品进行全面检验，并把结果向社会公布；另一方面借助官方网站和社交媒体，详细说明生产流程，还敞开工厂大门，请消费者代表实地参观。检测结果显示，该品牌奶粉各项指标都符合国家标准。几家主流报社随即发表文章澄清事实。调查发现，那篇文章的作者是一名替竞争对手做兼职的写手，他把国外的旧新闻稍加修改，冒充成国内的最新消息。目前，警方已经介入调查。事后，公司负责人表示，看到大部分消费者重新恢复了对品牌的信赖，感到十分欣慰。但他也坦言，在信息高度发达的今天，谣言的传播速度往往远远超过真相，企业有时显得无能为力。专家呼吁，公众在转发消息之前，应当学会区分事实和观点，不要被耸人听闻的标题迷惑；网络平台也应完善反馈机制，及时处理用户举报，让谣言无处藏身。
reading.en: Last month, an article headlined "Harmful Substances Found in Brand-X Infant Formula" spread rapidly online and for a while caused an uproar. Many parents grew alarmed after reading it, and some even threw away all the formula they had just bought. Under the circumstances, it was only natural for parents to panic. The brand's sales fell by nearly forty percent in just one week. Faced with this sudden crisis, the company at first chose to stay silent, hoping the storm would die down on its own — but the rumor only spread more widely. On the advice of public relations experts, the company finally made a public statement: on the one hand, it invited an authoritative testing agency to inspect its products thoroughly and published the results; on the other hand, it used its official website and social media to explain its production process in detail, and even opened its factory doors to consumer representatives for on-site visits. The test results showed that the brand's formula met national standards on every indicator. Several mainstream newspapers immediately published articles setting the record straight. An investigation found that the author of the article was a freelance writer working part-time for a competitor, who had taken old foreign news, changed it slightly and passed it off as the latest domestic news. The police have now stepped in to investigate. Afterwards, the head of the company said he was very relieved to see that most consumers had regained their trust in the brand. But he also admitted that in today's highly connected world, rumors often spread far faster than the truth, and companies sometimes seem powerless. Experts are calling on the public to learn to distinguish facts from opinions before sharing news, and not to be misled by sensational headlines; online platforms should also improve their feedback mechanisms and deal with user reports promptly, so that rumors have nowhere to hide.

grammar.title: Formal 'give': 予以 + verb
grammar.pattern: 对 + 对象 + 予以 + 支持 / 表扬 / 处罚 / 考虑
grammar.explain: 予以 (yǔyǐ) means 'to give, to grant' in official writing. It is followed by a two-syllable verb used like a noun (予以表扬, 予以处罚, 予以考虑), which makes the sentence sound formal and impersonal. The target is usually introduced earlier with 对.

grammar.title: Moreover: 况且
grammar.pattern: A ， 况且 + B （另一个理由）
grammar.explain: 况且 means 'moreover, besides'. It adds a further, often clinching, reason in support of a point already made, and is often followed by 又, 也 or 还. Compare 何况, which is often rhetorical ('let alone').

grammar.title: Just like: 犹如
grammar.pattern: A 犹如 B （比喻）
grammar.explain: 犹如 'just like, as if' is the written equivalent of 好像 or 像…一样 in comparisons. It is typical of literary description and formal speeches.

reading.title: “月光族”与“存钱族”
reading.zh: 随着生活日益富裕，年轻人的消费观念也在发生变化。有人每个月把工资花得一干二净，被称为“月光族”；也有人坚持储蓄，哪怕收入不高，也要每月存下一部分，被称为“存钱族”。两种生活方式，究竟哪一种更明智？小王是一名典型的“月光族”。新手机一上市，他就迫不及待地去买；看到喜欢的衣服，只要款式新颖，不管多贵都要买下来。他说：“钱是赚来花的，况且年轻时不享受，难道等老了再享受吗？”然而，一次意外住院，让他第一次意识到手里没有积蓄是多么被动。起初他想向朋友借钱，后来觉得丢人，只好用信用卡分期付款，结果每个月要多付不少利息。与小王不同，小李从工作第一天起就给自己定了规矩：工资到手，先存三成。在别人眼里，她似乎有些过于计较，连打车都要算一算值不值。可迄今为止，她已经存下了一笔可观的存款，还用其中一部分报了职业培训课程。“存钱不是为了发财，而是为了在需要的时候有选择的自由，免得被生活推着走。”经济学家指出，适度消费可以拉动经济，本身无可厚非；但过度消费、盲目攀比，实质上是一种贪婪的表现，它带来的满足感往往并不持久，购物之后人们反而更加空虚。专家建议，年轻人不妨按照“先储蓄、后消费”的惯例安排收入，同时保留一定的弹性，既不做守财奴，也不当“月光族”。
reading.en: As life grows more prosperous, young people's attitudes toward spending are changing too. Some spend every last cent of their salary each month and are called the "moonlight clan" (because their money is gone by the end of the month); others keep saving, putting part of their income aside every month even if they don't earn much, and are called the "savers". Which of these two lifestyles is wiser? Xiao Wang is a typical member of the "moonlight clan". As soon as a new phone comes out, he can't wait to buy it; when he sees clothes he likes, he buys them no matter the price, as long as the style is new. "Money is for spending," he says. "Besides, if you don't enjoy yourself when you're young, are you going to wait until you're old?" However, an unexpected stay in hospital made him realize for the first time how vulnerable he was with no savings. At first he thought of borrowing from friends, but then felt too embarrassed and ended up paying in installments on his credit card, which meant paying a lot of extra interest every month. Unlike Xiao Wang, Xiao Li set herself a rule from her first day at work: when her salary comes in, she saves thirty percent first. To others she may seem a little too calculating — she even works out whether a taxi ride is worth it. But so far she has saved a considerable sum, and has used part of it to sign up for a professional training course. "I don't save in order to get rich, but to have the freedom to choose when I need it, so that I'm not pushed around by life." Economists point out that moderate consumption can stimulate the economy and is perfectly reasonable in itself; but excessive spending and blindly keeping up with others are in essence a form of greed, and the satisfaction they bring is often short-lived — after shopping, people may feel even emptier. Experts suggest that young people follow the convention of "save first, spend later" when managing their income, while keeping some flexibility: be neither a miser nor a member of the "moonlight clan".

grammar.title: As always: 一如既往
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 一如既往 地 + 动词 ； 一如既往 的 + 名词
grammar.explain: This four-character idiom means 'just as before, as always'. Used with 地 it describes continued behavior, especially support or effort, and is frequent in speeches and official statements. With 的 it modifies a noun.

examples.zh: 我们 将 一如既往 地 支持 你们 的 工作 。
examples.en: We will continue to support your work as we always have.

examples.zh: 感谢 大家 一如既往 的 关心 和 帮助 。

grammar.title: Common knowledge and taken for granted: 众所周知 / 理所当然
grammar.pattern: 众所周知 ， + 公认事实 ； 认为 / 看作 + … + 理所当然
grammar.explain: 众所周知 'as everyone knows' introduces a widely known fact, usually at the start of a sentence. 理所当然 'only natural; a matter of course' describes something that seems to follow naturally — often critically, as in 把…看作理所当然 'take … for granted'.

examples.zh: 很多 孩子 把 父母 的 付出 看作 理所当然 的 事 。

grammar.title: Rhetorical 何尝
grammar.pattern: 何尝 + 不 + 动词 （= 其实也…） ； 何尝 + 动词 （= 并没有）
grammar.explain: 何尝 is a literary rhetorical adverb meaning 'when has… ever?'. 何尝不 means 'is it not also…? = it certainly is': 人生又何尝不是如此 'and isn't life just the same?'. Without a negative, 何尝 + verb means 'never really'.

reading.title: 瀑布前的思考
reading.zh: 去年秋天，我跟着一个观光团来到西南山区，专程去看那座有名的大瀑布。车子在山间公路上行驶，窗外群山起伏，云雾笼罩，宛如一幅水墨画。导游一再提醒我们：雨季刚过，水量很大，靠近瀑布时一定要当心脚下。还没看到瀑布，就先听到了它的声音，犹如千军万马奔腾而来。转过一个山口，眼前豁然开朗：一条白色的巨龙从几十米高的悬崖上猛烈地冲下来，溅起的水花在阳光下闪烁着七彩的光芒，气势十分壮观。游客们纷纷拿出相机，想要捕捉这难得的一刻。可是我发现，无论怎样拍，照片都无法描绘出它真正的神韵。站在观景台上，我身边有位头发花白、满脸皱纹的老人。他告诉我，这是他第五次来这里。“年轻时觉得瀑布就是瀑布，现在才明白，它日夜不停，一如既往地往下流，靠的是源源不断的流水。”老人的话给了我很大的启示。众所周知，瀑布的美来自落差，可是如果没有上游千百条小溪汇聚而成的河流，再高的悬崖也不会有瀑布。人生又何尝不是如此？我们往往只看到别人成功时的辉煌，却忽略了背后长年累月的积累。成功从来不是理所当然的，它是无数个平凡日子的精华。离开的时候，几只白鹭在广阔的山谷上空自由地飞翔，瀑布的声音渐渐远去，却一直在我心里回响。
reading.en: Last autumn I joined a sightseeing group to the mountains of the southwest, making the trip specially to see a famous waterfall. As our bus drove along the mountain road, peaks rose and fell outside the window, shrouded in clouds and mist like an ink-wash painting. The guide reminded us again and again that the rainy season had only just ended, the water was high, and we must watch our step near the falls. Before we saw the waterfall, we heard it — like thousands of horses galloping toward us. Rounding a mountain pass, the view suddenly opened up: like a white dragon, the water plunged violently from a cliff dozens of meters high, and the spray flashed with all the colors of the rainbow in the sunlight. It was a magnificent sight. Tourists pulled out their cameras one after another, trying to capture this rare moment. But I found that however I photographed it, no picture could capture its true spirit. On the viewing platform, there was an old man beside me with gray hair and a deeply wrinkled face. He told me it was his fifth visit. "When I was young, I thought a waterfall was just a waterfall. Only now do I understand that it keeps flowing down day and night, just as it always has, because of the endless water feeding it." His words were a revelation to me. As everyone knows, a waterfall's beauty comes from the drop; but without the river formed by hundreds of streams upstream, even the highest cliff would have no waterfall. And isn't life just the same? We often see only the glory of others' success and overlook the years of accumulation behind it. Success is never a matter of course; it is the essence distilled from countless ordinary days. As we left, a few egrets were soaring freely over the wide valley; the sound of the falls gradually faded behind us, but it kept echoing in my heart.

grammar.title: Be sure to: 务必
grammar.pattern: 务必 + 动词 ； 请 务必 …
grammar.explain: 务必 means 'must, be sure to'. It is a formal, emphatic way to ask or remind someone to do something important, typical of notices and instructions (请务必准时参加). It is stronger and more formal than 一定要.

examples.zh: 请 各位 务必 准时 到达 。
examples.en: Everyone, please be sure to arrive on time.

examples.en: This document must be handed in before Friday.

grammar.title: With the result that: 以致
grammar.pattern: 原因 ， 以致 + 不好的结果
grammar.explain: 以致 means 'so that, with the result that', and the result is usually undesirable. It begins the second clause and is formal. 以至(于) is similar but can also express a neutral degree ('to the point that').

examples.zh: 他 平时 不 注意 休息 ， 以致 病倒 了 。

grammar.title: A number of: 若干
grammar.pattern: 若干 + （量词） + 名词
grammar.explain: 若干 means 'a certain number of, several'. It is used in formal writing, regulations and reports (若干问题, 若干年后) in place of 一些 or 几 when the exact number does not matter.

reading.title: 百年老店的新挑战
reading.zh: 在城南一条狭窄的老街上，有一家创立于清朝末年的饭馆。一百多年来，它始终坚持“用料实在、童叟无欺”的经营宗旨，凭借地道的家乡风味和良好的信誉，成为当地公认的老字号。连最挑剔的美食家也称赞说，这里的烹饪手艺“还原了老一辈人记忆中的味道”。然而近年来，饭馆的生意却遇到了前所未有的挑战。一方面，周边新开的餐厅装修高档、菜品齐全，吸引了大量年轻顾客；另一方面，店里的老师傅陆续退休，年轻人又不愿意学这门又苦又累的手艺，以致客流量一度下降了三成以上。三年前，创始人的曾孙女小陈从国外留学回来，接任董事长。上任后，她做出了几个果断的决定：首先，在保留招牌菜的基础上，推出了若干款适合年轻人口味的新菜；其次，重新设计了店面布局，把传统的陶瓷餐具和现代的装饰风格结合起来，既保留了鲜明的特色，又提升了档次；最后，她制定了切实可行的培训方针，给年轻厨师提供施展特长的机会，还亲自带队到各地学习。对于这些改变，起初也有老员工不理解，认为她“把老祖宗的东西都改没了”。小陈耐心地跟他们沟通，在一些问题上也做出了让步。如今，饭馆不但恢复了往日的繁忙，还在外地开了三家分店。小陈说：“老店的生命力不在于一成不变，而在于守住初心、敢于创新。我衷心感谢老顾客多年来的关照，也希望新顾客能在这里找到属于自己的味道。”
reading.en: On a narrow old street in the south of the city, there is a restaurant founded at the end of the Qing dynasty. For over a hundred years it has held to its business principle of "honest ingredients, fair dealing for young and old", and with its authentic home-style flavors and good reputation, it has become a widely recognized time-honored brand in the area. Even the pickiest food critics praise its cooking for "recreating the taste remembered by the older generation". In recent years, however, the restaurant has faced unprecedented challenges. On the one hand, newly opened restaurants nearby, with upscale décor and full menus, have drawn large numbers of young customers; on the other hand, the restaurant's veteran chefs have been retiring one after another, and young people are unwilling to learn this hard and tiring craft. As a result, the number of customers once fell by more than thirty percent. Three years ago, Xiao Chen, the founder's great-granddaughter, returned from studying abroad and took over as chairwoman. After taking office, she made several decisive moves: first, while keeping the signature dishes, she introduced a number of new dishes suited to young people's tastes; second, she redesigned the layout of the restaurant, combining traditional porcelain tableware with modern decoration, which kept its distinctive character while raising its class; finally, she drew up a practical training policy that gives young chefs the chance to show their skills, and she personally led groups to learn from other places. At first some veteran employees did not understand these changes, saying she was "changing away everything our ancestors left us". Xiao Chen patiently talked things through with them and made concessions on some issues. Today the restaurant is not only as busy as it used to be, but has opened three branches in other cities. "An old restaurant's vitality lies not in never changing, but in staying true to its original spirit while daring to innovate," says Xiao Chen. "I sincerely thank our longtime customers for their support over the years, and I hope new customers can find a taste of their own here."

grammar.title: Formal cause: 致使
grammar.pattern: 原因 + 致使 + 结果（句子）
grammar.explain: 致使 means 'to cause, to result in'. It belongs to formal writing such as reports and news, and is almost always used for negative results. The subject is the cause, and what follows is a full clause describing the result.

examples.zh: 连日 暴雨 致使 多 条 道路 被 淹 。
examples.en: Days of heavy rain left many roads flooded.

examples.zh: 操作 失误 致使 机器 损坏 。
examples.en: An operating error caused the machine to break down.

grammar.title: Worthy of the name: 不愧
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 不愧 + 是 / 为 + 名词
grammar.explain: 不愧 means 'to be worthy of the name, to truly be'. It praises someone or something for living up to a title or reputation and is followed by 是 or 为 + noun.

examples.zh: 他 不愧 是 冠军 ， 表现 太 出色 了 ！

examples.zh: 这里 的 风景 不愧 为 “ 人间 天堂 ” 。

grammar.title: Itching to: 恨不得
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 恨不得 + 动作 （夸张）
grammar.explain: 恨不得 'to be itching to; to wish one could' expresses a strong, often exaggerated wish to do something impossible or inappropriate. It is colloquial and often paired with 马上 or 立刻.

examples.zh: 他 恨不得 马上 飞 回 家 。

reading.title: 沉睡千年的古城
reading.zh: 三年前，一支考古队在西北沙漠边缘进行地质调查时，意外发现了一片被黄沙掩埋的古城遗址。经过三年细致的发掘，这座沉睡了一千多年的城市终于揭开了神秘的面纱。据考古队负责人介绍，古城面积相当可观，城内有宫殿、寺庙、市场和民居，布局十分规整。在宫殿遗址中，工作人员小心翼翼地清理出了大量陶器、钱币和丝织品，其中不少物品明显来自遥远的西方，说明这里曾是丝绸之路上一个繁华的贸易中心。更令人惊喜的是，他们还发现了一批写在木片上的文献，内容涉及法律、税收和日常生活，为研究当时的社会提供了珍贵的第一手资料。那么，这座曾经辉煌的城市为什么会灭亡呢？学者们的见解并不一致。有人认为，是战争致使城市被毁；也有人根据地层中遗留的植物颗粒判断，当时气候变得越来越干燥，河流改道，城市失去了水源，居民不得不迁走。一位精通古代文字的老教授说：“这些文献中有不少关于缺水的记载，我更倾向于第二种说法。”目前，这个问题仍是一个悬念，有待进一步研究。如今，古城遗址周围一片寂静，只有风沙吹过断墙。但站在这里，人们仿佛还能听到千年前商人的叫卖声。这一发现不愧为近年来最重要的考古成果之一，它也引起了很多人的共鸣：人类文明再辉煌，如果不能与自然和谐相处，终究难逃被黄沙淹没的命运。
reading.en: Three years ago, while carrying out a geological survey on the edge of the northwestern desert, an archaeological team unexpectedly discovered the ruins of an ancient city buried under yellow sand. After three years of meticulous excavation, this city, which had slept for over a thousand years, has finally lifted its veil of mystery. According to the head of the team, the ancient city is considerable in size, with palaces, temples, markets and homes, all laid out in a very orderly way. In the palace ruins, workers carefully unearthed large quantities of pottery, coins and silk fabrics, many of which clearly came from the distant West, showing that the city was once a thriving trade center on the Silk Road. Even more exciting, they also found a batch of documents written on wooden strips, dealing with law, taxation and daily life, which provide precious first-hand material for studying the society of the time. So why did this once-glorious city perish? Scholars' views differ. Some believe war led to its destruction; others, judging from plant grains left in the soil layers, think the climate became increasingly dry, the river changed course, the city lost its water source, and the residents had to move away. An elderly professor who is an expert in ancient scripts said: "These documents contain many records of water shortages, so I lean toward the second explanation." For now the question remains unresolved and awaits further study. Today the ruins lie in complete silence, with only the wind and sand blowing past broken walls. Yet standing here, one can almost hear the cries of merchants from a thousand years ago. The discovery truly ranks among the most important archaeological finds of recent years, and it has struck a chord with many people: however glorious a civilization may be, if it cannot live in harmony with nature, it will in the end hardly escape being buried by the sand.

grammar.title: Always, all along: 向来
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 向来 + 形容词 / 动词短语 ； 向来 如此
grammar.explain: 向来 means 'always, all along'. It describes a habit, attitude or characteristic that has been consistent from the past until now (他向来守时). It is close to 一向 and often appears in 向来如此 'it has always been like this'.

examples.zh: 他 向来 说话 算数 。
examples.en: He has always been a man of his word.

examples.zh: 这里 的 冬天 向来 不 太 冷 。

grammar.title: No way to: 无从 + verb
grammar.pattern: 无从 + 得知 / 下手 / 说起 / 查证
grammar.explain: 无从 means 'to have no way of, not know where to (begin)'. It is formal and is followed by a two-syllable verb. Common phrases are 无从得知 'no way of knowing', 无从下手 'not know where to start' and 无从说起 'not know where to begin telling'.

grammar.title: Dare to: 勇于 + verb
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 勇于 + 承认 / 承担 / 创新 / 面对
grammar.explain: 勇于 means 'to have the courage to'. It is a positive, formal expression used to praise or encourage brave behavior, and is followed by a verb. 敢于 is similar.

reading.title: 一封郑重的道歉信
reading.zh: 去年冬天，一家开了二十年的服装厂因为订单锐减，面临倒闭的危险。为了让工厂活下去，厂长老周不得不做出一个痛苦的决定：解雇三分之一的工人。消息传出后，车间里一片沉默。不少工人在这里辛勤工作了十几年，有的甚至夫妻俩都在厂里。老周心里很清楚，对于这些人来说，失去工作意味着什么。宣布决定的前一天晚上，他一夜没睡，第二天一早就召集全体员工开会。会上，老周没有找任何借口。他郑重地向大家鞠了一躬，然后详细阐述了工厂面临的困境，并坦白承认，是自己在开拓新市场时过于保守，才使工厂陷入了今天的局面。“这不是你们的错，是我的错。我请求大家的谅解。”接下来的一个月，老周四处奔波，专程拜访了附近几家企业，想方设法为被解雇的工人寻找新的岗位。他还参照国家规定，制订了一份补偿方案的草案，在征求工人意见后，采纳了大家提出的几条建议，最终给每个人发放了比法律要求更高的补偿金。对于年纪较大、身体不好的工人，他安排专人照料，妥善解决了他们的后顾之忧。令人意外的是，很多被解雇的工人非但没有抱怨，反而表示能够体谅老周的难处。一位老工人说：“周厂长向来说话算数。他把我们当家人，我们也不能让他为难。”半年后，工厂渡过了难关，订单逐渐增加。老周做的第一件事，就是把当初离开的工人一个个请了回来。如今，厂里的气氛比以前更加融洽。老周常说：“企业最宝贵的不是机器，而是人心。”
reading.en: Last winter, a clothing factory that had been running for twenty years faced the danger of closing down after its orders plummeted. To keep the factory alive, its director, Old Zhou, had to make a painful decision: to lay off a third of the workers. When the news got out, the workshop fell silent. Many workers had worked hard there for over ten years, and in some cases both husband and wife worked at the factory. Old Zhou knew very well what losing their jobs would mean to these people. The night before announcing the decision he didn't sleep at all, and early the next morning he called a meeting of all the staff. At the meeting, Old Zhou made no excuses. He solemnly bowed to everyone, then explained in detail the difficulties the factory faced, and frankly admitted that it was because he himself had been too conservative in opening up new markets that the factory was now in this situation. "This isn't your fault, it's mine. I ask for your forgiveness." Over the following month, Old Zhou rushed around, making special trips to several nearby companies and doing everything he could to find new jobs for the laid-off workers. Referring to national regulations, he also drew up a draft compensation plan; after asking for the workers' views, he adopted several of their suggestions, and in the end paid everyone more compensation than the law required. For older workers and those in poor health, he arranged for someone to look after them, properly relieving their worries. Surprisingly, many of the laid-off workers not only did not complain but said they understood Old Zhou's difficulties. One veteran worker said: "Director Zhou has always kept his word. He treats us like family, so we can't make things hard for him." Six months later the factory got through its difficulties and orders gradually increased. The first thing Old Zhou did was to invite back, one by one, the workers who had left. Today the atmosphere at the factory is even more harmonious than before. Old Zhou often says: "A company's most precious asset is not its machines but people's hearts."

units.title: The Melting Arctic
units.goal: Read a popular-science article on climate change and evaluate opinions with 无非, 未免 and 进而.

extra.半天: a long time; half a day
extra.受: to be affected by; to receive
extra.打: to hit; to fight; to play

grammar.title: Nothing but: 无非
grammar.pattern: 无非 + （是） + … （而已 / 罢了）
grammar.explain: 无非 'nothing more than, simply' reduces something to what it really is, often in a slightly dismissive tone. It is often followed by 是 and may end with 而已 or 罢了.

examples.zh: 他 说 了 半天 ， 无非 是 想 借 钱 。
examples.en: For all his talk, he just wanted to borrow money.

examples.zh: 成功 的 秘诀 无非 是 坚持 。

grammar.title: A bit too: 未免
grammar.pattern: 未免 + （太 / 有点 / 过于） + 形容词
grammar.explain: 未免 expresses mild, tactful criticism: 'rather, a bit too'. It softens a negative judgement and is usually followed by 太, 有点 or 过于 + adjective, often ending with 了.

examples.zh: 你 这样 说 未免 太 不 公平 了 。

examples.zh: 只 看 一 次 就 下 结论 ， 未免 有点 草率 。

grammar.title: And further: 进而
grammar.pattern: A ， 进而 + B
grammar.explain: 进而 'and then, and further' links two steps where the second builds on the first. It is formal and common when explaining processes or developing an argument.

reading.title: 北极的冰在哭泣
reading.zh: 在很多人的印象中，北极是一片茫茫的冰雪世界，与我们的日常生活似乎相隔遥远。然而，科学家们发现，近几十年来，北极气温上升的速度是全球平均水平的三倍以上，夏季海冰的面积急剧减少。卫星图片显示，一些原本被冰层覆盖的岛屿如今已经露出了地面；大块的浮冰漂浮在海上，北极熊不得已长距离游泳寻找食物。导致这一现象的主要原因是空气中二氧化碳等温室气体的增加。工厂、汽车大量燃烧煤炭、石油和柴油，排放出的气体就像给地球盖上了一床厚厚的被子，使热量无法散发出去。冰雪融化后，深色的海水吸收更多阳光，进而让气温继续升高，形成恶性循环。有人认为，北极离我们那么远，冰化了无非是北极熊的事，跟人类关系不大。这种想法未免太天真了。专家断定，北极海冰的消失会改变大气环流，导致世界各地出现反常天气：夏天更热，冬天更冷，洪水和干旱更加频繁。海平面上升还会威胁到沿海城市的安全。面对这一全球性问题，各国在减排责任上曾存在不少争端，甚至一度形成对立。经过多年的交涉与会晤，越来越多的国家达成了合作意向，确立了共同应对气候变化的框架。不过，专家提醒，补救的时间已经不多了。除了政府施加政策压力、企业改良技术、开辟新能源以外，每个普通人也应该提高觉悟：少开一天车，随手关一盏灯，看似微不足道，却都是在为地球降温。
reading.en: In many people's minds, the Arctic is a vast world of ice and snow, seemingly far removed from our daily lives. Scientists have found, however, that in recent decades Arctic temperatures have been rising more than three times as fast as the global average, and the area of summer sea ice has shrunk dramatically. Satellite images show that some islands once covered by ice are now exposed; large chunks of ice float on the sea, and polar bears have no choice but to swim long distances in search of food. The main cause of this phenomenon is the increase in greenhouse gases such as carbon dioxide in the air. Factories and vehicles burn huge amounts of coal, oil and diesel, and the gases they emit act like a thick quilt over the Earth, preventing heat from escaping. When ice and snow melt, the darker seawater absorbs more sunlight, which in turn pushes temperatures higher, creating a vicious circle. Some people think the Arctic is so far away that melting ice is simply a problem for polar bears and has little to do with humans. This view is rather naive. Experts are certain that the disappearance of Arctic sea ice will alter atmospheric circulation and cause abnormal weather around the world: hotter summers, colder winters, and more frequent floods and droughts. Rising sea levels will also threaten the safety of coastal cities. Faced with this global problem, countries once had many disputes over responsibility for cutting emissions, and at one point were even at loggerheads. After years of negotiations and meetings, more and more countries have reached agreements of intent and established a framework for tackling climate change together. Experts warn, however, that time to put things right is running out. Besides governments applying policy pressure, companies improving technology and opening up new energy sources, every ordinary person should also raise their awareness: driving one day less a week or switching off a light as you leave may seem trivial, but each helps to cool the planet.

grammar.title: Up to (a time): 截至
grammar.pattern: 截至 + 时间 ， + 统计结果
grammar.explain: 截至 means 'up to, as of (a point in time)'. It introduces the cut-off time for figures in news and reports. Do not confuse it with 截止 'to close; deadline' (报名截止).

grammar.title: Easy to: 便于

grammar.title: Without exception: 一律
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 一律 + 动词 / 形容词

reading.title: 高原上的老师
reading.zh: 大学毕业那年夏天，我报名参加了一个支教项目，来到一所海拔三千多米的山区小学。这里交通不便，学校条件也十分简陋，全校只有四名老师，却要负责六个年级的所有科目。刚到的时候，我对一切都感到茫然：高原反应让我头疼、喘不过气来，学生们说的方言我也听不太懂。更让我心疼的是，很多孩子性情内向，有些甚至有点自卑，上课时不敢抬头看老师。我不知道从哪里着手，只好一边上课，一边摸索。学校的老校长在这里已经教了三十年书。他记性不太好，常常找不到眼镜，可每个学生的名字和家庭情况，他都记得清清楚楚。他告诉我：“这些孩子缺的不是聪明，而是信心。”在他的建议下，我利用课余时间组织了一个文艺小组，教孩子们唱歌、画画、表演。起初只有三四个人参加，后来连最淘气的男孩也主动来报名了。为了便于孩子们练习，我还抽空把课本上的歌一首首抄在黑板上。半年后，学校举办了第一次文艺演出。孩子们依次走上台，一律穿着干干净净的衣服，在灿烂的阳光照耀下，大声地唱着、笑着。台下的家长们顿时安静下来，很多人眼里含着泪水。演出结束时，全体学生向老师们深深地鞠了一躬。那一刻，我觉得自己所做的一切虽然微不足道，却名副其实地值得。离开那天，孩子们把我送到村口，一直站在我跟前不肯走。我凝视着他们一张张黑黑的小脸，心里充满了留恋。如今我已回到城市工作，但每年暑假都会回去看看。老校长那种踏实、仁慈的精神，一直让我深深钦佩。我想，我会竭尽全力把这种精神发扬下去。
reading.en: The summer I graduated from university, I signed up for a volunteer teaching program and went to a mountain primary school more than three thousand meters above sea level. Transport there was poor and the school was very basic: there were only four teachers for the whole school, yet they were responsible for every subject across six grades. When I first arrived, I felt lost about everything: altitude sickness gave me headaches and left me short of breath, and I could barely understand the students' dialect. What upset me even more was that many of the children were introverted, and some even felt rather inferior, not daring to look up at the teacher in class. I didn't know where to start, so I just taught and felt my way along. The school's old principal had been teaching there for thirty years. His memory wasn't very good — he was always losing his glasses — yet he remembered every student's name and family situation perfectly. He told me: "What these children lack isn't intelligence, it's confidence." On his suggestion, I organized an arts group in my spare time, teaching the children to sing, draw and perform. At first only three or four joined, but later even the naughtiest boy came to sign up on his own. To make it easier for the children to practice, I also found time to copy the songs from the textbook onto the blackboard one by one. Six months later, the school held its first arts performance. The children went on stage one after another, all dressed in clean clothes, singing and laughing loudly in the bright sunshine. The parents in the audience instantly fell silent, and many had tears in their eyes. At the end of the show, all the students bowed deeply to the teachers. At that moment I felt that, though what I had done was insignificant, it had been truly worthwhile. On the day I left, the children walked me to the edge of the village and stood in front of me, refusing to go. Gazing at their small, sun-darkened faces, my heart was full of reluctance to leave. Now I'm back working in the city, but I go back to visit every summer holiday. I have always deeply admired the old principal's down-to-earth, kind-hearted spirit, and I will do everything I can to carry it forward.

grammar.title: Admittedly…but: 固然…，但…
grammar.pattern: A 固然 + 优点 / 事实 ， 但 / 可是 / 也 + 另一方面
grammar.explain: 固然 'admittedly, of course' concedes a point before introducing a more important consideration with 但是, 可是 or 也. It is more formal than 虽然 and stresses that the conceded point is true but not the whole picture.

grammar.title: If (literary): 倘若

reading.title: 让传统艺术“活”起来
reading.zh: 书法、杂技、剪纸、刺绣……这些传统艺术曾经是人们日常生活的一部分。然而，随着生活节奏加快和娱乐方式的多元化，昔日辉煌的传统艺术渐渐远离了年轻人的视野。不少老艺人感叹，手艺无人继承，实在令人惋惜。传统艺术的衰落固然有时代的原因，但也与其自身的传播方式有关。长期以来，很多传统艺术团体只着重技艺的传承，却忽视了观众的需求，节目内容陈旧，形式单一，自然难以吸引年轻人。倘若一味守着老一套，不肯改变，传统艺术恐怕只能进博物馆了。可喜的是，近年来，一批年轻的传承人开始觉醒，积极寻找新的出路。一个杂技团借鉴了现代舞台剧的手法，用灯光、音乐和故事把一个个惊险的动作串联起来，形式新颖，演出场场爆满；一位书法老师在网上开设直播课程，用轻松幽默的方式分享自己练字的心得，吸引了几十万名粉丝。他们的经验说明，传统与现代并不对立，关键在于找到恰到好处的结合点。专家认为，当务之急是转变观念：既要立足于传统，又要合乎当代人的审美。政府可以倡导和支持，但不应把传统艺术仅仅当成“保护对象”，耗费大量资金却收效甚微。只有让市场发挥导向作用，借助新媒体等传播媒介，才能真正打破传统艺术“叫好不叫座”的格局，让它在新时代重新焕发光彩。
reading.en: Calligraphy, acrobatics, paper cutting, embroidery... these traditional arts were once part of everyday life. However, as the pace of life speeds up and forms of entertainment diversify, traditional arts that were glorious in the past have gradually faded from young people's view. Many veteran artists lament that no one is inheriting their crafts, which is a real pity. The decline of traditional arts certainly has to do with the times, but it is also related to the way they are passed on. For a long time, many traditional arts troupes focused only on handing down technique and ignored what audiences wanted; with outdated content and monotonous forms, they naturally struggled to attract young people. If they cling to the old ways and refuse to change, traditional arts may end up only in museums. Encouragingly, in recent years a number of young inheritors have begun to wake up and actively look for new ways forward. One acrobatics troupe borrowed techniques from modern stage drama, using lighting, music and storytelling to link thrilling stunts together; the format is fresh, and every show sells out. A calligraphy teacher started live-streamed classes online, sharing what she has learned from practicing writing in a relaxed and humorous way, and attracted hundreds of thousands of fans. Their experience shows that tradition and modernity are not opposed; the key is to find just the right meeting point. Experts believe the most urgent task is to change mindsets: to stay rooted in tradition while matching contemporary tastes. The government can advocate and support, but should not treat traditional arts merely as "objects of protection", spending large sums of money with little effect. Only by letting the market play a guiding role and using new media and other channels can we truly break the pattern of traditional arts being "praised but not attended", and let them shine again in a new era.

units.title: A Fisherman's Son
units.goal: Read a biographical sketch and highlight exceptions, degrees and long traditions with 唯独, 以至 and 历来.

grammar.title: The only exception: 唯独
grammar.pattern: … 都 … ， 唯独 + A + （不 / 没）…
grammar.explain: 唯独 'only, alone' singles out one exception against a general situation. It usually follows a clause containing 都, and the exception it introduces is often negative.

examples.zh: 大家 都 同意 了 ， 唯独 他 一 个 人 反对 。
examples.en: Everyone agreed except him.

examples.zh: 别的 菜 我 都 爱 吃 ， 唯独 不 吃 香菜 。
examples.en: I like all other vegetables — only coriander I won't eat.

grammar.title: To the extent that: 以至（于）
grammar.pattern: A ， 以至 / 以至于 + 程度 / 结果
grammar.explain: 以至 or 以至于 means 'to the extent that, so much so that'. It introduces a result showing how great the degree of the first clause is; the result may be neutral or negative. Compare 以致, which almost always introduces a bad result.

examples.zh: 他 看 书 看 得 太 投入 了 ， 以至于 连 饭 都 忘 了 吃 。
examples.en: He was so absorbed in his book that he even forgot to eat.

examples.zh: 变化 太 快 ， 以至 很多 人 都 不 适应 。
examples.en: Things changed so fast that many people couldn't adapt.

grammar.title: Always, traditionally: 历来 vs 向来
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 历来 / 向来 + 谓语
grammar.explain: Both mean 'always, all along'. 历来 stresses 'throughout history, as far back as one knows' and is often used of traditions, peoples and institutions. 向来 is more personal, describing someone's consistent habit or attitude.

examples.zh: 中国 人 历来 重视 家庭 。
examples.en: Chinese people have always valued the family.

examples.zh: 他 向来 说话 算数 。

reading.title: 从渔村走出的科学家
reading.zh: 最近出版的一本传记，讲述了材料科学家林海的故事。林海出生在南方一个小渔村，父亲是一位普通的渔民。小时候，他最喜欢在港湾边捡贝壳，望着来来往往的轮船出神。家里穷，连买书的钱都没有，他就千方百计地向别人借书看，有时为了借一本书，要走十几里路。村里人历来认为“读书不如打鱼”，唯独他的母亲坚持让他上学。她常对儿子说：“咱们穷，但要自力更生，做个品行端正的人。”上大学以后，林海才发现自己的基础很薄弱，学起来十分吃力。但他性格坚韧，每天比别人早起两个小时学习，硬是打下了扎实的基础。毕业后，他被选派到国外深造，其间恰巧赶上一个尖端材料的研究项目。由于当时国内这一领域几乎是空白，他决定学成后立刻回国。回国初期，实验条件十分艰苦，研究一度陷入停滞。有人劝他放弃，他却说：“别人能做到的，我们一定也能做到。”他带领团队力争每一个数据都精确无误，经过八年努力，终于攻克了关键技术难题。新材料问世后，大大降低了造船的成本，带来了巨大的经济效益，被同行誉为该领域的里程碑。如今，林海培养的年轻人才不断涌现，他却依旧过着简朴的生活。每年春节，他都会回到渔村与家人团圆。看着家乡的变迁，他时常感叹：“我这辈子大体上只做了一件事，但我觉得值得。”读完这本传记，很多读者赞叹：这是一个平凡而真挚的故事，正因为平凡，才格外动人。
reading.en: A recently published biography tells the story of the materials scientist Lin Hai. Lin Hai was born in a small fishing village in the south; his father was an ordinary fisherman. As a child, he loved collecting shells by the harbor and gazing at the ships coming and going. His family was poor and couldn't even afford books, so he did everything he could to borrow them, sometimes walking several miles to borrow a single book. The villagers had always believed that "studying is not as good as fishing"; only his mother insisted that he go to school. She often told her son: "We're poor, but we must stand on our own feet and be people of upright character." At university, Lin Hai discovered that his foundation was weak and found his studies a real struggle. But he was tenacious: he got up two hours earlier than everyone else every day to study, and through sheer determination built a solid foundation. After graduating he was selected to study abroad, where he happened to join a research project on cutting-edge materials. Since the field was almost a blank back home at the time, he decided to return as soon as he finished his studies. In his early years back home, laboratory conditions were very harsh and the research once ground to a halt. Some advised him to give up, but he said: "What others can do, we can certainly do too." He led his team in striving to make every figure exact, and after eight years of effort they finally overcame the key technical problem. Once the new material came out, it greatly reduced the cost of shipbuilding and brought huge economic benefits; his peers hailed it as a milestone in the field. Today, young talents trained by Lin Hai keep emerging, yet he still lives a simple life. Every Spring Festival he goes back to the fishing village for a family reunion. Seeing how his hometown has changed, he often remarks: "In this life I've basically done only one thing, but I think it was worth it." Having finished the biography, many readers exclaim that it is an ordinary yet heartfelt story — and precisely because it is ordinary, it is especially moving.

units.goal: Read a profile of a scientist who popularizes astronomy and reason about consequences with 势必, 反之 and 索性.

grammar.title: Bound to: 势必
grammar.pattern: 原因 / 主语 + 势必 + （会 / 将） + 结果
grammar.explain: 势必 'to be bound to, will certainly' predicts an inevitable consequence from the present situation. It is formal and common in analysis and commentary, and often pairs with 会 or 将.

examples.zh: 不 采取 措施 ， 污染 势必 会 越来越 严重 。
examples.en: If no measures are taken, pollution is bound to get worse.

examples.zh: 人口 老龄化 势必 给 社会 带来 新 的 挑战 。
examples.en: An aging population will inevitably bring new challenges to society.

grammar.title: Conversely: 反之
grammar.pattern: A ， B ； 反之 ， C
grammar.explain: 反之 'conversely, otherwise' introduces the opposite case in a line of reasoning: the first part gives a condition and its result, and after 反之 comes what happens under the opposite condition. It is formal.

examples.zh: 努力 就 会 进步 ， 反之 就 会 落后 。

examples.zh: 需求 大 ， 价格 就 会 上涨 ； 反之 ， 价格 就 会 下降 。

grammar.title: Might as well: 索性
grammar.pattern: （既然…）， 索性 + 动作
grammar.explain: 索性 'might as well; simply' describes deciding to go all the way or take a decisive step after weighing up a situation, often because a half-measure won't work. The colloquial equivalent is 干脆.

reading.title: 把星空讲给大家听
reading.zh: 在天文学界，张教授是一位举足轻重的人物。他常年钻研宇宙起源的问题，提出的学说为这一领域的研究奠定了重要基础。然而，让他在普通人中出名的，却是他写的科普书。二十年前，张教授在一次讲座上发现，很多人对天文知识的了解少得惊人，有人甚至认为流星是“星星掉下来了”。他颇为诧异，也意识到问题的严重：如果科学知识只停留在少数专家之间，愚昧和迷信势必会乘虚而入；反之，如果大众都具备基本的科学素养，社会就会更加理性。从那以后，他本着“让每个人都能看懂”的原则，开始利用业余时间写科普文章。写科普并不容易。为了让外行也能理解复杂的推论，他常常反复修改，把公式换成生活中的例子。比如，为了说明宇宙有多大，他列举了一组数据：如果把太阳缩小成一个篮球，那么地球只有芝麻那么大，而离太阳最近的恒星，还在几千公里以外。这样一比较，大家对宇宙的尺度就一目了然了。他的书语言通俗、图文并茂，出版后多次重印，成了许多中学生的启蒙读物。熟悉张教授的人都说，他为人和蔼，生活朴实，胸怀宽广。在他的带领下，研究所培养出了一大批业务骨干。如今已年过七十的他，仍然坚持每周为中学生做一次讲座。他说：“俗话说‘授人以鱼，不如授人以渔’。普及科学，不仅是传播知识，更是帮助年轻人建立正确的世界观。这是每个科学家力所能及的事情。”
reading.en: In the world of astronomy, Professor Zhang is a figure of great importance. He has spent years delving into the origin of the universe, and the theory he proposed laid an important foundation for research in the field. Yet what made him famous among ordinary people was the popular-science books he wrote. Twenty years ago, at a lecture, Professor Zhang discovered that many people knew astonishingly little about astronomy; some even thought meteors were "stars falling down". He was quite taken aback and realized how serious the problem was: if scientific knowledge stays among a few experts, ignorance and superstition are bound to fill the gap; conversely, if the public has basic scientific literacy, society will be more rational. From then on, guided by the principle of "making it understandable to everyone", he began writing popular-science articles in his spare time. Writing popular science is not easy. To help laypeople follow complex reasoning, he would revise again and again, replacing formulas with examples from everyday life. For instance, to show how big the universe is, he gave a set of figures: if the sun were shrunk to the size of a basketball, the Earth would be as small as a sesame seed, and the nearest star to the sun would still be several thousand kilometers away. With a comparison like this, the scale of the universe becomes clear at a glance. His books are written in plain language, richly illustrated, and have been reprinted many times, becoming introductory reading for many secondary school students. People who know Professor Zhang say he is kind, lives simply and is broad-minded. Under his leadership, his institute has trained a large number of key researchers. Now over seventy, he still gives a lecture to secondary school students every week. "As the saying goes, 'Give a man a fish and you feed him for a day; teach a man to fish and you feed him for a lifetime.' Popularizing science is not only about spreading knowledge but also about helping young people form a correct worldview. It is something every scientist can do."

grammar.title: Can't help: 不由得
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 不由得 + 动词 ； 不由得 + 你 + 不 + 动词
grammar.explain: 不由得 means 'can't help (doing)', very close to 不禁. It can also mean 'leaves no choice but': 不由得你不信 'you have no choice but to believe it'.

examples.zh: 想起 往事 ， 他 不由得 叹 了 一 口 气 。
examples.en: Thinking of the past, he couldn't help sighing.

examples.zh: 证据 都 摆 在 面前 ， 不由得 你 不 信 。
examples.en: With the evidence in front of you, you have no choice but to believe it.

grammar.title: For the time being: 暂且
grammar.pattern: 暂且 + 动词 （先这样，以后再说）
grammar.explain: 暂且 means 'for now, for the time being'. It marks a temporary arrangement, usually implying that the matter will be returned to later. It is slightly more literary than 暂时.

examples.zh: 这 件 事 暂且 不 谈 ， 我们 先 讨论 下 一 个 问题 。
examples.en: Let's set this aside for now and discuss the next issue.

examples.zh: 你 暂且 住 在 这里 ， 等 找到 房子 再 搬 。
examples.en: Stay here for the time being and move when you find a place.

grammar.title: In short / it goes without saying: 总而言之 / 不言而喻
grammar.pattern: 总而言之 ， + 总结 ； … 是 不言而喻 的
grammar.explain: 总而言之 'in short, all in all' introduces a summary at the end of an argument. 不言而喻 'it goes without saying' marks something as self-evident; it often comes at the end in the form …是不言而喻的.

reading.title: 一座矿业小镇的转型
reading.zh: 五十年前，地质队在西部一个偏远的乡镇勘探时发现，这里的地下蕴藏着丰富的煤炭。从此，小镇因矿而兴：工人从四面八方涌来，街道上商店林立，一度十分兴旺。然而，几十年的大规模开采之后，资源逐渐枯竭，煤矿一个接一个地关闭。年轻人纷纷外出打工，小镇变得越来越荒凉。前几年，一场罕见的洪水又冲毁了部分道路和房屋，真是雪上加霜。面对困境，很多人无可奈何，认为小镇已经没有希望了。新上任的镇长却不这么看。他带领干部走访了几百户居民，实事求是地分析了小镇的优势：周围有山有水，气候宜人，还保留着不少老矿区的建筑。“与其等着外面的人来救我们，不如自己谋求出路。”他倡议依托这些独特的资源发展旅游业。转型的过程颇费周折。资金不够，他们就分步实施；缺少人才，就请专家来培训。镇政府坚持务实的作风，不搞形象工程，把有限的钱用在刀刃上。几年下来，废弃的矿坑被改造成了湖泊和园林，老厂房变成了展示矿业历史的博物馆。去年，一座现代化的游客中心正式落成，开放当天，镇上的居民兴高采烈，像过节一样。据统计，去年全镇共计接待游客八十多万人次，旅游收入在全镇经济中所占的比重已超过一半。如今，这座“矿业小镇”在省内家喻户晓，不少外出打工的年轻人也回来开起了民宿和饭馆。一位老矿工感慨地说：“过去我们靠挖煤过日子，现在靠好山好水吃饭。”看着热闹的街道，他不由得笑了起来。总而言之，小镇的故事告诉我们：只要敢于改变，资源枯竭并不意味着走到了尽头。
reading.en: Fifty years ago, while prospecting in a remote western township, a geological team discovered rich coal reserves underground. From then on the town flourished thanks to mining: workers poured in from all directions, shops lined the streets, and for a time it thrived. But after decades of large-scale mining, the resources gradually ran out and the mines closed one after another. Young people left in droves to find work elsewhere, and the town grew more and more desolate. A few years ago, a rare flood washed away some of its roads and houses — adding insult to injury. Faced with these difficulties, many people felt helpless and thought there was no hope left for the town. The newly appointed mayor saw things differently. He led officials to visit several hundred households and made a realistic analysis of the town's strengths: it was surrounded by hills and water, had a pleasant climate, and still preserved many buildings from the old mining area. "Rather than waiting for outsiders to rescue us, let's find our own way forward." He proposed developing tourism based on these unique resources. The transformation was full of twists and turns. When funds were short, they implemented the plan step by step; when they lacked talent, they brought in experts to train people. The town government stayed pragmatic, avoiding vanity projects and spending its limited money where it counted most. Over several years, abandoned mining pits were turned into lakes and gardens, and old factory buildings became a museum showing the history of mining. Last year, a modern visitor center was officially completed; on its opening day, the townspeople were as jubilant as if it were a festival. According to statistics, the town received a total of more than eight hundred thousand visits last year, and tourism now accounts for over half of the local economy. Today the "mining town" is a household name in the province, and many young people who had left to work elsewhere have come back to open guesthouses and restaurants. An old miner said with feeling: "We used to live by digging coal; now we live off beautiful hills and rivers." Looking at the bustling streets, he couldn't help smiling. In short, the town's story tells us that as long as we dare to change, running out of resources does not have to mean the end of the road.

grammar.title: Unexpectedly: 不料
grammar.pattern: A ， 不料 + 意外的情况
grammar.explain: 不料 'unexpectedly, to one's surprise' introduces an unforeseen turn of events, usually at the start of the second clause. It is literary; the spoken equivalent is 没想到.

grammar.title: Tentatively: 姑且

grammar.explain: 姑且 means 'tentatively, for the moment'. It suggests accepting or trying something provisionally, even if it isn't ideal. It is more literary than 暂且.

grammar.title: Eager to: 巴不得 vs 恨不得
grammar.pattern: 主语 + 巴不得 + 愿望 ； 主语 + 恨不得 + 夸张的愿望
